games.name: [G0Z] Delta Worlds RPG
games.desc:
Public-Alpha V PA 4.9.7 Chaser Route

One day you wake up and your friend Shopkeeper calls you to help him with one little thing: Saving the world... the Earth...
The game has the same world logic as DELTARUNE - there are LIGHT and DARK worlds, which had their balance shift, but three Delta Warriors managed to set up the balance, containing 3 types of worlds: LIGHT, DARK and SHADOWED. But today, SHADOWED worlds have begun to shift the balance... in which the Earth might be at its edge.

This game has Undertale/Deltarune inspired turn-based RPG battle system, with its own story, music, sprites and 3D overworld!
The game was inspired by Undertale/Deltarune by Toby Fox, so go support him!

We highly recommend playing UNDERTALE or DELTARUNE before playing this game to better understand the battle mechanics.

Credits are located in the game's settings.

Delta Worlds RPG © MyRobloxStudio 2023 - 2026
